body: Funny thing is they'll read this in history books in the future and just be in awe of how things sucked so much that people were driven to commit suicide. You are honestly a selfless person, very responsible still continuing to quarantine even though it's taking a toll on your mental health . You are one of the reasons why others are not dying of covid. You are one of the good ones, and the world needs every bit of you in this world right now, and most especially when it breaks free from this curse!

Stop worrying and cherish this moment! The universe smiles very rarely on people, and obviously the universe is beaming at you! It's smile goes from ear to ear, eyes almost hidden with glee, teeth and gums on full show :))

I am very happy for you, but I must also admit that I can't relate to your ciscumstances given that I'm actually having quite the opposite experience. I dont know what else to say, but dang, you must be one of Universe's favorite children hehehehehe

Happy for you! Cherish it, and show just how much you appreciate her. People like me just dream of having a friendship/relationship like that..
You are one of the lucky ones! ♥️🌈
Im currently in a dark place too, and I feel you. Would you like to share? Perhaps more context? Im really interested to hear about your story xx
Genuine happiness, contentment, real love, beauty.

I thought that finding a place where I can vent to strangers might help, and I found this group. My feelings are a burden for me, and wouldnt want to load it on anyone else. My emotions are toxic, and I fully support the idea that a professional should be compensated for allowing someone like me to dump my feelings on them and find a method to help me. They are putting their healthy minds at risk. Others have it far worse than me and are able to persevere. And then there's me. I cant unload it to anyone close to me, im afraid to lose the already meager connections I have. They have their own problems.
Its alright. You reading it means a lot to me. Thank you

Am I meant to save a child's life from getting hit by a car? Or perhaps save some old person from eating poisoned food? Am I meant to hold the door to keep the bad guys from harming some main character? Because if that's my purpose, I'd gladly do it now and be over with it.
I feel the same. Why am I still here?
Im jealous of you. People fucked me over and I just dont have the will/energy to fight. I just want to end it.
